Date: 2025-11-24
Title: Trading in bonds KZ2C00015253 (NITCb2) and KZ2C00015279 (NITCb3) of National Information Technologies will open on KASE as of November 25
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1555685/
Body: /KASE, November 24, 2025/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) announces 
that trading in the following bonds of National Information Technologies JSC
will  open on KASE as of November 25, 2025:

- KZ2C00015253 (KASE main market, category "bonds", NITCb2; KZT 1,000, 
  KZT 15.0 bn; 05.09.25 – 05.09.30; semi-annual coupon, 15.57 % per annum; 
  30/360);

- KZ2C00015279 (KASE main market, category "bonds", NITCb3; KZT 1,000, 
  KZT 4.9 bn; 05.09.25 – 05.09.30; semi-annual coupon, 18.33 % per annum; 
  30/360).

The accuracy of quoting the specified bonds in KASE's trading system is set to 
the fourth decimal place of the bond's "clean" price, expressed as a percentage 
of the par value; the quotation currency is the Qazaq tenge.

More detailed information on these bond issues is available at 
https://kase.kz/en/listing/issuers/NITC

following terms (Astana time).

Trade initiator:                       Tengri Partners Investment Banking (Kazakhstan) JSC
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As the price an order must indicate the coupon rate expressed in annual 
percentage of the bond's face value with accuracy of up to the second decimal 
place.

The number of financial instruments in an order must be indicated as the number 
of bonds in pieces. The number of financial instruments in an order must be 
equal to or be a multiple of the lot size.

As the volume an order must quote the product of the bonds' number, indicated 
in the order, and the face value of one bond.

The deal volume is calculated in compliance with Chapter 4 of the Methodology 
for Calculation of Bonds' Yield and Amounts of Deals in Bonds available at 
https://kase.kz/files/normative_base/bond_yield_eng.pdf

Settlements will be made by the Central Securities Depository JSC in compliance 
with its rules. The buyer of securities must ensure the availability of money 
payable for securities bought at the correspondent account in the Central 
Securities Depository JSC by the payment time indicated in the table.

Only KASE stock market members may submit orders for participation in the 
trades. Other investors can submit orders through those legal entities. The list
of  KASE stock market members is available at 
https://kase.kz/en/members/membership/all

The Regulations on Methods of Trading in the Trading and Clearing Systems are 
available at – 
https://kase.kz/files/normative_base/methods_ASTS_eng.pdf

Details of the mentioned bond issue are available at 
https://kase.kz/en/investors/bonds/HCBNb16

-------------------------

Date: 2024-09-24
Title: AS OF OCTOBER 1, KASE STARTS CALCULATION AND PUBLICATION OF ESG BOND INDICES
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1529758/
Body: /KASE, September 24, 2024/ – From October 1, 2024, Kazakhstan Stock 
Exchange (KASE) will begin calculating and publishing the following ESG indices 
and indicators:

- KASE_ESGB_CP – index of "clean" prices of ESG bonds included in the 
  main and alternative markets of KASE official list;

- KASE_ESGB_DP – index of "dirty" prices of ESG bonds included in the 
  main and alternative markets of KASE official list;

- KASE_ESGB_Y – indicator of the yield of the ESG bond index (in percent 
  per annum);

- ESG bond index duration (in years).

The launch of the calculation of ESG bond indices was implemented with the aim 
of developing the ESG bond market on KASE in accordance with global trends in 
the development of the "green" economy.

The formulas for calculating ESG bond indices contain a standard approach to 
the generally accepted methodology for determining indices for debt instruments.
The price of ESG bonds for calculating indices and indicators will be the price 
determined in accordance with the internal document of KASE Clearing Centre 
"Methodology for determining settlement prices of securities", until market 
participants show significant interest in ESG bonds.

The initial value of the KASE_ESGB_CP index is fixed at 100.00 points, the
initial  value of the KASE_ESGB_DP index is fixed at 100.00 points with the
addition of  the average value of the accumulated coupon interest (in percent).

The index values will be calculated once a day on business days at 17:30 Astana 
time and published on KASE's Internet resource in the section "Stock Market 
Indicators" – https://kase.kz/en/stock_market/

As previously reported, from October 1, KASE's revised internal document 
"Methodology for calculating stock market indices and indicators" (Methodology) 
will be put into effect, which defines the methodology for calculating ESG bond 
indices.

The revised methodology will be published on KASE's Internet resource at 
https://kase.kz/en/kase_rules/ (tab "Methodologies").

Title: Since May 14, trades in international bonds US912810FJ26 (US_04_2908) 
and US91282CCT62 (US_09_2408) of U.S. Department of Treasury 
suspended on KASE

Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1521139/
Body: /KASE, May 14, 2024/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) notifies you that 
since May 14, 2024, trading on repo transactions in trading modes involving the 
central counterparty whose settlement date falls on August 14, 2024 and 
subsequent dates, has been suspended on KASE on the following international 
bonds of the U.S. Department of the Treasury:

- US912810FJ26 (sector "government securities", US_04_2908);

- US91282CCT62 (sector "government securities", US_09_2408).

Trading was suspended in accordance with sub-item 10) of item 1 of Article 11-2 
of KASE's internal document "Rules for execution of exchange activities" due to 
the receipt by KASE of information that the record date for said bonds is August
14, 2024.

Trading in said bonds on KASE will be resumed from August 16, 2024.

Date: 2023-08-31
Title: From August 31, KASE excluded bonds KZ2C00001188 (EUBNb5) of 
Eurasian Bank from representative list of indicators of KASE_BM* series 
due to maturity

Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1507638/
Body: /KASE, August 31, 2023/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) has excluded 
bonds KZ2C00001188 (EUBNb5) of Eurasian Bank JSC from the representative 
list for calculating indicators of the corporate bond market of the main market 
(KASE_BM* series) from August 31, 2023 due to their maturity (August 31 – 
record date).

From August 31, 2023, the representative list of KASE_BM* series indicators will 
consist of bonds of 58 names.

KASE_BMY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BMC – corporate bond price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without account to accrued interest thereon (at "clean" prices).

The said indicator is calculated by KASE once a day according to results of 
trades in corporate bonds.

The Methodology is available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Date: 2022-08-22
Title: From August 22, KASE excluded bonds KZ2C00007508 (KFUSb17) of Kazakhstan Sustainability Fund from representative list of indicators of KASE_BM* series due to maturity
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1487414/
Body: /KASE, August 22, 2022/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) has excluded bonds 
KZ2C00007508 (KFUSb17) of Kazakhstan Sustainability Fund JSC from the 
representative list for calculating indicators of the corporate bond market
of the main market (KASE_BM* series) from the representative list from 
August 22, 2022 due to their maturity (August 22 – record date).

From August 22, 2022, the representative list of KASE_BM* series indicators will
consist of 58 titles of bonds.

KASE_BMY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BMC – corporate bond price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without account to accrued interest thereon (at "clean" prices).

The said indicator is calculated by KASE once a day according to results of 
trades in corporate bonds.

The Methodology is available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Title: From June 13, KASE excluded bonds KZ2C00007458 (KFUSb12) of Kazakhstan Sustainability Fund from representative list of indicators of KASE_BM* series due to maturity
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1483634/
Body: /KASE, June 13, 2022/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) has excluded bonds 
KZ2C00007458 (KFUSb12) of Kazakhstan Sustainability Fund JSC from the 
representative list for calculating indicators of the corporate bond market
of the main market (KASE_BM* series) from the representative list from June 13,
2022 due to their maturity (June 13 – cut-off day).

From June 13, 2022, the representative list of KASE_BM* series indicators will 
consist of 62 titles of bonds.

KASE_BMY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BMC – corporate bond price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without account to accrued interest thereon (at "clean" prices).

The said indicator is calculated by KASE once a day according to results of 
trades in corporate bonds.

The Methodology is available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

deal. The decision was made in connection with the receipt of the above 
information, as well as in connection with the presence of these securities in
the  accounting system of the Central Securities Depository and the possible 
presence of open positions on them among trading participants.

At the same time, we recommend that trading participants follow the news when 
concluding transactions with these securities and independently assess the level
of risk appetite.

Date: 2021-07-19
Title: From July 19 KASE removes bonds KZ2C00001618 (CSBNb10) of Kaspi Bank from KASE_BM* series indices' universe due to maturity
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1464577/
Body: /KASE, July 19, 2021/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) from July 19, 2021 
removed bonds KZ2C00001618 (CSBNb10) of Kaspi Bank from the universe for 
calculation of indicators of the main market's corporate bond market (series 
KASE_BM*) due to their maturity.

From July 19, 2021, the universe of KASE_BM* series indices will consist of 
bonds of 49 titles.

KASE_BMY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BMC – corporate bond price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without account to accrued interest thereon (at "clean" prices).

The said indicator is calculated by KASE once a day according to results of 
trades in corporate bonds.

http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Date: 2021-04-08
Title: KASE's Management Board fixes Q2 2021 weighted average yield rates for calculation of fair value of illiquid debt securities of organizations – residents of Republic of Kazakhstan
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1456496/
Body: /KASE, April 8, 2021/ – Following a decision of the Management Board of 
Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE or the Exchange) dated April 8, 2021, the 
following weighted average yield rates for calculation of the fair value of 
illiquid debt securities issued by organizations – residents of the Republic 
of Kazakhstan were fixed for the second quarter of 2021:

1) on tenge-denominated non-indexed debt securities:

  for category "bonds" of the main market – 8.55 % APR;

  for category "commercial bonds" of the main market – 10.67 % APR;

  for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 17.08 % APR;

  for category "commercial bonds" of the alternative market – 16.42 % APR;

2) on tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at inflation or with a floating 
   rate, independent from the exchange rate of the tenge to a foreign currency;

  for category "bonds" of the main market – 13.11 % APR.

  for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 5.75 % APR.

KASE's Management Board made a decision not to fix the weighted average 
yield rate of debt securities for groups of securities, in respect of which it
is impossible to calculate values of this rate.

The procedure for calculation of the weighted average yield rate of debt 
securities was determined by the new internal document of KASE "Methodology 
for Calculation of the Weighted Average Yield Rate of Illiquid Debt Securities
and  for Determining their Fair Value" (hereinafter – the Methodology), approved
by a  decision of KASE's Board of Directors dated April 11, 2018.

We remind you that the mentioned weighted average yield rates are determined 
in accordance with the Rules for Accounting and Assessment of Pension Assets 
approved by the Resolution No. 24 of the National Bank of the Republic of 
Kazakhstan dated February 26, 2014 (the Rules) as follows:

1) according to item 17 of the Rules, the Exchange must weekly release on its 
   website the data on the fair value of illiquid debt securities issued by
   resident- organizations of the Republic of Kazakhstan and included in the
   Exchange’s  Official List. The mentioned securities mean securities, the
   market value  (yield) of which cannot be calculated in accordance with the
   Exchange's  internal document "Methodology for Securities Valuation";

2) According to item 16 of the Rules, the fair value of the mentioned securities
   is  determined based on the Methodology. The weighted average yield rate is 
   determined by the Exchange's Management Board once a quarter for each 
   particular category (sub-category) of the "Debt securities" sector as part of
   separate markets of the stock exchange's official list for each of the
   following  groups of securities:

   tenge-denominated non-indexed debt securities;

   tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at the inflation or with a
   floating  rate (independent from the exchange rate of the tenge to the foreign 
   currency);

   tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at the exchange rate of the tenge
   to the US dollar and US dollar-denominated debt securities.

For reference: on August 3, 2020, KASE put into effect the new edition of the 
Methodology for Securities Valuation (minutes No. 19 of the meeting of the Board
of Directors dated June 9, 2020). This Methodology allows calculating prices of 
all securities, including illiquid ones. This Methodology was put into effect in
connection with the introduction by the Exchange of the institution of the
central counterparty and the risk management system, which includes a system
for evaluating securities.

Methodology for Securities Valuation is available on KASE website – 
https://kase.kz/files/normative_base/met_ocen_zb_eng.pdf

The methodology for calculating the weighted average yield on illiquid debt 
securities and determining their fair value is available on KASE website –  
http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/metodika_discountrates_eng.pdf

[2021-04-08]

-------------------------

Date: 2021-01-20
Title: KASE's Management Board fixes Q1 2021 weighted average yield rates for calculation of fair value of illiquid debt securities of organizations – residents of Republic of Kazakhstan
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1451298/
Body: /KASE, January 20, 2021/ – Following a decision of the Management Board of 
Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE or the Exchange) dated January 19, 2021, 
the following weighted average yield rates for calculation of the fair value 
of illiquid debt securities issued by organizations – residents of the 
Republic of Kazakhstan were fixed for the first quarter of 2021:

1) on tenge-denominated non-indexed debt securities:

  for category "bonds" of main market – 8.81 % APR;

  for category "commercial bonds" of the main market – 10.75 % APR;

  for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 17.84 % APR;

  for category "commercial bonds" of the alternative market – 12.69 % APR;

2) on tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at inflation or with a floating 
   rate, independent from the exchange rate of the tenge to a foreign currency;

   for category "bonds" of the main market – 13.09 % APR.

   for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 5.75 % APR

3) on tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at the exchange rate of the 
  tenge to a foreign currency and debt securities denominated in a foreign 
  currency:

 for category "bonds" of the main market – 5.92 % APR.

KASE's Management Board made a decision not to fix the weighted average 
yield rate of debt securities for groups of securities, in respect of which it
is  impossible to calculate values of this rate.

The procedure for calculation of the weighted average yield rate of debt 
securities was determined by the new internal document of KASE "Methodology 
for Calculation of the Weighted Average Yield Rate of Illiquid Debt Securities
and  for Determining their Fair Value" (hereinafter, the Methodology) approved
by a  decision of KASE's Board of Directors dated April 11, 2018.

We remind you that the mentioned weighted average yield rates are determined 
in accordance with the "Rules for Accounting and Assessment of Pension 
Assets" approved by the Resolution of the National Bank of the Republic of 
Kazakhstan No. 24 dated February 26, 2014 (the Rules) as follows:

1) according to item 17 of the Rules, the Exchange must weekly release on its 
   website the data on the fair value of illiquid debt securities issued by
   resident- organizations of the Republic of Kazakhstan and included in the
   Exchange’s  Official List. The mentioned securities mean securities, the
   market value  (yield) of which cannot be calculated in accordance with the
   Exchange's  internal document "Methodology for Securities Valuation";

2) According to item 16 of the Rules the fair value of the mentioned securities
   is  determined based on the Methodology.  Weighted average yield rate is 
   determined by the Exchange's Management Board once a quarter for each 
   particular category (sub-category) of the "Debt securities" sector as part of
   separate markets of the stock exchange's official list for each of the
   following  groups of securities:

 tenge-denominated non-indexed debt securities;

 tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at the inflation or with a
 floating  rate (independent from the exchange rate of the tenge to the foreign 
 currency);

 tenge-denominated debt securities indexed at the exchange rate of the tenge
 to the US dollar and US dollar-denominated debt securities.

The Methodology is published on KASE website (in Russian) – 
http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/metodika_discountrates_eng.pdf –

[2021-01-20]

Date: 2020-01-23
Title: Bonds KZ2C00001634 (KASTb3) of KAZEXPORTASTYK Holding removed from KASE Official List as of January 23
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1423192/
Body: /KASE, January 23, 2020/ – The Listing Commission of the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) made a decision on January 22, 2020 to remove bonds KZ2C00001634  (KASE 
main market, category "bonds", KASTb3; kZT1,000, KZT40.0 bn; July 18, 2011 – July 
18, 2029; annual coupon 8.00 % APR; 30/360) of KAZEXPORTASTYK Holding (Nur-Sultan) 
from KASE Official List.

This decision of the Listing Commission comes into effect on January 23, 2020.

The KASE conclusion report dated January 15, 2020 says that the company in its 
letter of November 26, 2019 informed that it is unable to pay coupon interest
on said bonds for the periods from February 23, 2015 to July 17, 2015 and from
July 18, 2018 to November 15, 2019 on a timely basis by November 29, 2019.

According to sub-item 1) of item 16 of the Requirements to Issuers and Their 
Securities Being Admitted (Admitted) to Trading on a Stock Exchange and 
Requirements to Specific Categories of a Stock Exchange’s List approved by the 
Resolution of Board of the National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 54 
dated March 27, 2017, issuer’s default on payment of interest on its obligations
serves as justification for the transfer of its debt securities to the "buffer
category" category of KASE Official List.

On December 30, 2019, the company submitted the Action Plan on rectifying the 
grounds for the transfer of its bonds to the category "buffer category" of the 
KASE Official List approved by the Board of Directors’ resolution dated December 
27, 2019 (Action Plan).

The Listing Commission rejected the Action Plan by its decision.

Based on the foregoing and in accordance with sub-item 4) of item 35 of the 
Requirements, these bonds have been excluded from the KASE Official List.

These bonds were included in KASE Official List under category "Rated Debt 
Securities" on July 18, 2011. They have been in main market’s category "bonds" 
of KASE Official List since June 1, 2017.

Trades in them opened on October 17, 2011.

[2020-01-23]

 for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 10.54 % APR;

 for category "commercial bonds" of the alternative market – 9.90 % APR;

2) on tenge-denominated debt securities indexed to inflation or to an independently 
   floating rate independent from the exchange rate of tenge to foreign currency:

for category "bonds" of the main market – 11.78 % APR;

for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 7.09 % APR;

3) on tenge-denominated debt securities indexed to exchange rate of tenge to the 
   foreign currency and debt securities denominated in foreign currency;

 for category "bonds" of the main market – 5.40 % APR;

 for category "bonds" of the alternative market – 14.37 % APR;

KASE's Management Board made a decision not to fix weighted average yield rate of 
debt securities for groups of securities, in respect of which it is impossible to 
calculate values of this rate.

The procedure for calculation of weighted average yield rate of debt securities 
was determined by the new KASE internal document "Methodology for Calculation of 
the Weighted Average Yield Rate of Non-Marketable Debt Securities and for 
Determining their Fair Value" (hereinafter, the Methodology) approved by the 
resolution of KASE Board of Directors dated April 11, 2018.

We remind you that the mentioned weighted average yield rates are determined in 
accordance with the "Rules for Accounting and Assessment of Pension Assets" 
approved by the Resolution of the National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 
24 dated February 26, 2014 (the Rules) as follows:

1) according to item 17 of the Rules, the Exchange must weekly release on its 
   website the data on the fair value of non-marketable debt securities issued
   by  resident-organizations of the Republic of Kazakhstan and included in the 
   Exchange’s Official List. The mentioned securities mean securities, the market 
   value (yield) of which cannot be calculated in accordance with the Exchange’s 
   internal document "Methodology for Securities Valuation";

2) According to item 16 of the Rules the fair value of the mentioned securities
   is  determined based on the Methodology.  Weighted average yield rate is 
   determined by the Exchange's Management Board once a quarter for each particular 
   category (sub-category) of "Debt securities" sector as part of separate markets 
   of the stock exchange's official list for the following groups of securities:

 tenge-denominated unindexed debt securities;

 tenge-denominated debt securities indexed to inflation or to an independently  
 floating rate independent from the exchange rate of tenge to foreign currency;

 tenge-denominated debt securities indexed to the exchange rate of tenge to US 
 dollar and dollar-denominated debt securities.

The Methodology is published on KASE website (in Russian) – 
https://kase.kz/files/normative_base/metodika_discountrates_eng.pdf

[2020-01-15]

Date: 2019-06-07
Title: Transactions with international bonds XS1263054519 (KZ_07_2507) of the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Kazakhstan will be executed on KASE according to the settlement scheme Т+2 in US dollars as of June 10
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1404880/
Body: /KASE, June 7, 2019/ – By the decision of the Management Board of the Kazakhstan 
Stock Exchange (KASE), international bonds XS1263054519 (KASE Official List, 
sector "State securities" KZ_07_2507) of the Ministry of Finance of the Republic 
of Kazakhstan will be included onto the Exchange-cleared List of Stock Market 
Financial Instruments.

As of June 10, 2019, transactions with these bonds will be executed on KASE 
according to the settlement scheme Т+2 in US dollars.

We remind that trading in Eurobonds with settlements in US dollars is conducted 
in a separate version of the KASE trading system using T+2 settlement scheme 
(on the second day after the transaction) and clearing based on the trading day 
results. This scheme allows making transactions with partial collateral. The 
delivery of the asset for settlements must be performed by the trading participant  
by 17:00 o'clock (Almaty time) of the settlement day.

Listed debt securities denominated in foreign currencies are traded on KASE 
according to scheme Т+0 with settlements in Kazakhstani tenge and full preliminary 
pre-depositing of the asset before submission of an order and conclusion of a 
transaction is necessary.

The procedure for including financial instruments to the List of Exchange-cleared  
Stock Market Financial Instruments is available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/order_instruments_eng.pdf

The Rules of Executing Clearing Activities on Deals in Financial Instruments are
available on KASE website

http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/clearing_rules_eng.pdf

Body: /KASE, May 23, 2019/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) notifies you that 
from May 23, 2019 trading in bonds KZ2C00001493 (KASE alternative market, 
category "bonds", ALTMb1) of Almatytemir (Almaty) was resumed on KASE.

Trading in said bonds was suspended on KASE from March 13, 2019 due to 
the general meeting of holders of said bonds on March 13, 2019.

Trading in said bonds was resumed after KASE received amendments to the 
issue prospectus of said bonds adopted on March 13, 2019 at the general 
meeting of bondholders and registered by the National Bank of the Republic of 
Kazakhstan on May 16, 2019. According to the amendments, the security for 
liabilities on said bonds, the procedure, terms and deadlines of implementing 
an early repurchase of bonds, as well as other terms related to default, 
covenants were changed.

Central Securities Depository in its letter of May 22, 2019 announced that from 
May 22, 2019 registration of transactions in said bonds was resumed in its 
accounting system.

Amendments to the issue prospectus of said bonds are available on KASE 
website – http://kase.kz/files/emitters/ALTM/altmf9_ALTMb1_izm_160519.PDF

Earlier there was a related KASE news item dated March 13, 2019 "Trading in 
Almatytemir bonds KZ2C00001493 (ALTMb1) has been suspended on KASE 
as of March 13, 2019" – http://kase.kz/en/news/show/1397095/

[2019-05-23]

Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1399645/

trades in corporate bonds.

Date: 2019-04-05
Title: International bonds XS1134544151, US48667QAK13 (KMGZe9) of National company "KazMunayGaz" removed from KASE official list as of April 5 due to early redemption
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1398573/
Body: /KASE, April 5, 2019/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) notifies you that as 
of April 5, 2019 international bonds XS1134544151, US48667QAK13 (KASE main 
market, category "bonds", KMGZe9; USD1.0 bn; November 7, 2014 – November 7, 2044; 
semi-annual coupon 6.0 % APR; 30/360) of National company "KazMunayGaz" (Nur-Sultan) 
were removed from KASE official list due to their early redemption.

National company "KazMunayGaz" has in an official letter informed KASE about an 
early complete repurchase of said bonds on April 4, 2019.

The Central Securities Depository has in an official letter informed KASE that 
the early redemption of said bonds was registered in its accounting system.

Said bonds were included in KASE official list's "Rated debt securities"
category on November 7, 2014; since June 1, 2017 they had been in the category 
"bonds" of KASE official list's main market. Trades in them opened on 
November 20, 2014.

We remind you that said bonds were traded on KASE according to scheme Т+0 with 
settlement in Kazakh tenges and according to scheme Т+2 with settlement in US 
dollars.

[2019-04-05]

   Centras Securities.

liquidity  classes for April – May 2019 are available on KASE website at

Title: As of January 24 trading in Tsesnabank bonds KZ2C00004430 (TSBNb33) will be suspended on KASE
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1393180/
Body: /KASE, January 23, 2019/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Management Board, as of January 24, 2019 trading in bonds KZ2C00004430 
(KASE main market, category "bonds", TSBNb33) of Tsesnabank (Astana) will be 
suspended on KASE.

According to the decision of the Management Board of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE), if the decision on approving changes to the issue prospectus of these 
bonds is taken at the general meeting of holders of these bonds which will be 
held on January 24, 2019, the period for suspension of trading will be extended 
to the day following the date of receipt by KASE of relevant amendments to the 
issue prospectus bonds and confirmation from Central Securities Depository about 
the renewal of its placement and circulation in its accounting system.

Trades in the mentioned bonds on KASE will be resumed on the next business day 
after the receipt by KASE of relevant changes to the issue prospectus of these 
bonds and confirmation from Central Securities Depository about renewal of their 
placement and circulation in its accounting system.

By the same decision of Management Board of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) it 
was established that if the general meeting of holders of these bonds will not  
take place and/or if the decision on approving changes to the issue prospectus of 
these bonds will not be  accepted, trades in these bonds will be resumed from the 
next working day after receiving the relevant notice from Tsesnabank.

Earlier there was a related KASE news item dated January 21, 2019 "General meeting 
of  holders of bonds KZ2C00004430 (TSBNb33) of Tsesnabank due on January 24, 2019"

Title: KASE removes Eurasian Bank bonds KZ2C00001204 (EUBNb7) from representative list of KASE_BM* series indices reaching maturity date
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1393973/
Body: /KASE, January 21, 2019/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) as of January 21, 2019 
removed bonds KZ2C00001204 (EUBNb7) of Eurasian Bank JSC from the representative 
list of the main market indexes (series KASE_BM*) since they reached their maturity 
date.

As of January 21, 2019, the representative list of KASE_BM* series indices will 
consist of bonds of 37 titles.

KASE_BMY – corporate bonds yield indicator.

KASE_BMC – corporate bonds price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without regard to the accrued interest thereon (by "clean" prices).

These indicators are calculated by KASE once a day according to results of 
trades in corporate bonds.

The index calculation methodology is regulated by KASE internal document 
"Methodology of Stock Market Indices Calculation", which is available on KASE 
website at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Date: 2018-12-11
Title: KASE PREPARES LISTS OF SECURITIES OF INVESTMENT FUNDS OF FIRST, SECOND AND THIRD LIQUIDITY CLASSES FOR DECEMBER 2018 – JANUARY 2019
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1390018/
Body: /KASE, December 11, 2018/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE, or the Exchange) in 
an extraordinary mode prepared lists of securities of investment funds (SIF) of 
the first, second and third liquidity classes for December 2018 – January 2019 
out of SIF, admitted for circulation on KASE.

These lists were approved by a decision of the Committee on Indexes and 
Securities Valuation dated December 11, 2018 and were prepared for purposes 
of using in respect to SIF, quoted therein, of norms of internal documents of 
KASE "Regulations on Trades and Confirmation System Operation" and 
"Procedure of inclusion of financial instruments in the Lists of stock markets' 
financial instruments, cleared by the Exchange".

Below are lists of SIF of the first, second and third liquidity classes which
will be valid from December 12, 2018 to January 31, 2019 (names of securities
are indicated in the descending order of their liquidity indicator).

The list of the first class:

1) units US78462F1030 SPDR S&P 500 ETF TRUST under management of State Street 
   Global Advisors, KASE official list, sector "Securities of investment funds", 
   trade code - US_SPY_;

2) units KZPFN0002068 (KZPF00000025) of IUIT "Eurobonds fund" under  management 
   of Centras Securities, KASE official list, sector "Securities of investment 
   funds", trade code - CSECfe;

3) shares IE00BG0C3K84 of segregated sub-fund FinEx FFIN Kazakhstan Equity ETF, 
   KASE official list, sector "Securities of investment funds", trade  code - 
   IE_FXBF.

The decision on inclusion of shares IE_FXBF in the list of the first class
liquidity  was taken in accordance with item 17 of KASE internal document
"Methodology  of Securities Liquidity Indicators Defining" due to the
availability of factors, which  allow considering said shares as potentially
liquid. The Exchange refers to the  mentioned factors the following:

- opening as of October 16 of trading in shares of the segregated sub-fund 
  FinEx FFIN Kazakhstan Equity ETF on the Moscow Exchange; from the moment of 
  opening of trading in said shares more than 4 th. deals in the amount of around 
  RUB10 mln, or equivalent to KZT49.6 mln, were concluded;

- the written intention of Freedom finance to act as the market-maker for 
  IE_FXBF on KASE from the date of opening of trading in them on the Exchange.

The list of the second class liquidity contains SIF with one name – units 
KZPFN0002019 (KZPF00000033) of IUIT "Centras- Global markets" under management 
of Centras Securities, KASE official list, sector "Securities of investment funds", 
trade code - CSECgm.

The list of the third class:

1) units KZPFN0033154 (KZPF00000066) of IUIT "ORKEN" under management of Freedom 
   Finance, KASE official list, sector "Securities of investment funds", trade 
   code - ASYL_or;

2) units KZPFN0012216 (KZPF00000058) of IUIT "CenterCredit-Valyutniy" under 
   management of BCC Invest – subsidiary of Bank CenterCredit, KASE official 
   list, sector "Securities of investment funds", trade code - BCCI_cc;

3) unit KZPFN0009170 (KZPF00000041) of IUIT "Halyk – Valyutniy" under management 
   of Subsidiary of Halyk Savings Bank of Kazakhstan "Halyk Finance", KASE official 
   list, sector "Securities of investment funds", trade code – HFINhv.

Said lists of the first, second and third liquidity classes for December 2018 – 
January 2019 will be released on KASE website at 
http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/

The Regulations on Trades and Confirmation System Operation are available at 
http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/reglament_trade_eng.pdf

The Procedure of inclusion of financial instruments in the Lists of stock
markets' financial instruments cleared by the Exchange is available at 
https://kase.kz/files/normative_base/order_instruments_eng.pdf

The Methodology of Securities Liquidity Indicators Defining is available at 
http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/metodika_liquid_eng.pdf

[2018-12-11]

Date: 2018-12-11
Title: KASE removed bonds KZ2C0Y07E152 (KZ2C00001691, PRKRb5) of National Company Food Contract Corporation from representative list for bond market indices of KASE_BM* series due to their maturity
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1389862/
Body: /KASE, December 11, 2018/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) as of December 11, 
2018 removed bonds KZ2C0Y07E152 (KZ2C00001691, KASE main market, category "bonds", 
PRKRb5, KZT1,000, KZT40.0 bn; November 12, 2011 – November 12, 2018; fixed semi-
annual coupon 7.50 % APR; 30/360) of National Company Food Contract Corporation 
from the representative list for the market indices calculation of the main market 
(series KASE_BM*) due to their maturity (December 11 is the maturity record date):

As of December 11, 2018, representative list of KASE_BM* indices will consist of 
bonds of 41 names.

KASE_BMY – corporate bonds yield index.

KASE_BMC – corporate bonds price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without account of the accrued interest thereon (by "clear" prices).

These indicators are calculated by KASE once a day according to results of trades 
in corporate bonds.

Index calculation technique is regulated by the KASE internal document 
"Methodology of Stock Market Indices Calculation", which is available on KASE 
website at http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2018-12-11]

Date: 2018-09-17
Title: AS OF SEPTEMBER 17 KASE LAUNCHES EUROBONDS TRADING WITH SETTLEMENTS IN US DOLLARS ACCORDING TO Т+2 SCHEME
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1381982/
Body: /KASE, September 17, 2018/ – As announced earlier, Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE or the Exchange) launches trading in listed Eurobonds with settlements in 
US dollars as of September 17, 2018.

The purpose of opening Eurobonds trading with settlements in US dollars on KASE 
is to provide individuals and legal entities with access to trading and 
settlements in debt securities, denominated in foreign currency, without 
performing additional currency conversion procedures.

Trading in Eurobonds with settlements in US dollars will be carried out in a 
separate version of the trading system using the Т+2 settlement scheme (on the 
second day after the deal conclusion) and clearing based on the trading day 
results. This scheme allows concluding deals with partial securing. At that, the
delivery of the asset for settlements must be performed by the trading participant  
by 17:00 o'clock (Almaty time) of the settlement day.

As of September 17, 2018, by the decision of KASE Management Board listed 
international bonds of 20 titles are included in the List of Stock Market 
Financial  Instruments, Transactions in which are Cleared by the Exchange". The
list is  provided for in the KASE news item of September 17, 2018 "AS OF 
SEPTEMBER 17 LISTED EUROBONDS OF 20 TITLES WILL BE TRADED ON KASE WITH SETTLEMENTS 
IN US DOLLARS" –  
http://kase.kz/en/news/show/1381938/

Currently, listed debt securities denominated in foreign currencies are traded
on KASE according to scheme Т+0 with settlements in the Kazakh tenge and the 
necessity of full preliminary depositing of the assets before the moment of 
submitting the application and conclusion of a deal. Trading in Eurobonds with 
settlement scheme Т+0 in the Kazakh tenge will be continued on KASE as usual.

As of August 3, 2018 respective amendments to KASE internal documents were 
made effective:

- Method of Calculation of Bond Yield and Bond Transaction Sum – 
  http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/bond_yield_eng.pdf

- Instruction on Procedure of Coding of Members of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange, 
  Financial Instruments and Securities Issuers – 
  http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/code_fins_eng.pdf

As of September 17, 2018 the following KASE internal documents were put into 
effect:

- Revised "Procedure of execution of deals on the stock market according to 
  scheme T+2" http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/por_t2_new.pdf

- Revised "Procedure of Inclusion of Financial Instruments in the List of Stock 
  Market Financial Instruments, Transactions in which are Cleared by the 
  Exchange"– http://kase.kz/files/normative_base/order_instruments.pdf

[2018-09-17]

Date: 2018-07-26
Title: /REPEAT/ Trades in bonds KZP02Y05F570 (KZ2C00003994, SNRGb3) of Samruk-Energy will be suspended on KASE from July 27
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1377391/
Body: /KASE, July 26, 2018, newsrepeat July 20, 2018/ – By the decision of the Management 
Board of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) trades in bonds KZP02Y05F570 (KZ2C00003994, 
KASE main market, category "bonds", SNRGb3) of Samruk-Energy(Astana) will be suspended 
on KASE from July 27, 2018

According to the decision of the Management Board of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE),if the decision on approving changes to the issue prospectus of these bonds 
is taken at the general meeting of holders of these bonds which will be held on 
July 27, 2018, the period for suspension of trading will be extended to the day 
following the date of receipt by KASE of relevant amendments to the issue prospectus 
bonds and confirmation from Central Securities Depository about the renewal of its 
placement and circulation in the system of its accounting.

Trades in the mentioned bonds on KASE will be resumed on the next business day 
after the receipt by KASE of relevant changes to the issue prospectus of these 
bonds and confirmation from Central Securities Depository about renewal 
of their placement and circulation in the system of its accounting.

By the same decision of Management Board of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) it
was established that if the general meeting of holders of these bonds will not  
take place and / or if the decision on approving changes to the issue prospectus 
of these bonds will not be  accepted, trades in these bonds will be resumed from 
the next working day after receiving the relevant notice from Samruk-Energo.

Earlier on this topic was published KASE news from July 5, 2018 "General 
meeting of bondholders KZP02Y05F570 (KZ2C00003994, SNRGb3) of Samruk-
Energo will be held on July 27, 2018".
http://kase.kz/ru/news/show/1375377/

[2018-07-26]

Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1373078/
Body: /KASE, 13.06.18/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) as of June 13, 2018 
removed bonds KZ2C0Y01F525 (KZ2C00003937, KASE main market, category 
"bonds", MREKb10, KZT1,000, KZT1.5 bn; 06.06.08 – 06.06.18; fixed annual, 
15.00 % APR; 30/360) of "Mangistau Distribution Electricity Network Company" 
JSC (Aktau) from the representative list for the market indices calculation 
of the  main market (series KASE_BM*) due to their maturity (June 13 – record
date).

As of June 13, 2018 representative list of KASE_BM* indices will consist of 
bonds of 43 names.

KASE_BMY – corporate bonds yield index.

KASE_BMC – corporate bonds price index calculated according to bonds' prices 
without account to accrued interest thereon (by "clear" prices).

These indicators are calculated by KASE once a day according to results of 
trades in corporate bonds.

Index calculation technique is regulated by the KASE internal document 
"Methodology of Stock Market Indices Calculation", which is available on KASE 
website at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met.pdf

Date: 2017-09-28
Title: AS OF SEPTEMBER 29, 2017 KASE EXTENDS LIST OF SECURITIES USED AS UNDERLYING ASSETS IN AUTO REPO TRANSACTIONS
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1349416/
Body: /KASE, September 28, 2017/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Management Board dated September 28, 2017, changes and additions No. 8 
(amendments) to KASE internal document "Specification of Auto Repo Market" 
(Specification) were approved, with effect as of September 29, 2017.

KASE reminds you that in accordance with the Specification, debt securities 
from the CS basket can be used as underlying assets of auto repo transactions. 
These securities must be listed on KASE, denominated in tenge and have an 
issue rating not lower than "ВВ-" on the international scale of rating agency 
Standard & Poor's or a similar rating on the international scale of another
rating  agency.

Also, debt securities not from the CS basket can be used as underlying assets 
of auto repo transactions. Such securities must be listed on KASE, denominated 
in tenge and have a rating not lower than "В-" on the international scale of 
rating agency Standard & Poor's or a similar rating on the international scale
of other rating agencies.

Amendments also specify that debt securities not from the CS basket can be 
used as underlying assets of auto repo transactions, if they were not rated, but
their issuer has a rating not lower than "В-" on the international scale of
rating agency Standard & Poor's or a similar rating on the international scale
of other rating agencies, and if those bonds are not subordinated, termless or 
securitized.

We remind you that corporate securities in order to be used as underlying assets
of auto repo transactions, must also comply with other conditions listed in item
13 of the Specification.

Amendments were made for purposes of extending the list of securities used on 
KASE as underlying assets of auto repo transactions.

The revised text of the Specification will be released soon on KASE website – 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/sp_repo_eng.pdf

[2017-09-28]

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid out.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by KASE internal document 
"Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at

accepted providing for removal of reasons for a transfer of bonds KZ2C0Y23B676 
(KZ2C00000701, KASE alternative market, category "bonds", DTJLb1; KZT1,000,

coupon, 7.95 % APR for the current coupon period, 30/360) of Doszhan Temir

official list's alternative market.

In KASE's summary dated September 15, 2017 it is pointed out that in August 2017
Doszhan Temir Zholy (DTZ) committed partial default on payment of interest for
the 12th coupon period (from August 2, 2016 to August 1, 2017) on said bonds.

In accordance with sub-item 1) of item 16 of the Requirements for issuers and
their securities (being) admitted to circulation on the stock exchange, as well
as for particular categories of stock exchange list approved by a resolution
No. 54 of the  Management Board of the National Bank of Republic of Kazakhstan
dated March 27, 2017, if an issuer commits default on payment on interest on
its bonds (except for the interest for the last coupon period in case that debt
securities issue is the sole issue of debt securities of that issuer in the
exchange's official list) that can be a reason for a transfer of its debt
securities into the "buffer" category of the respective market of KASE official
list.

On August 29, 2017 Doszhan Temir Zholy (DTZ) provided KASE with an action 
plan on removal of reasons for a transfer of its securities into the "buffer"
category of KASE official list's alternative market.

In accordance with item 24 of said Requirements, from September 22, 2017 said 
bonds were transferred from category "bonds" into the "buffer" category of KASE 
official list's alternative market.

Date: 2017-07-14
Title: SUBSCRIPTION TO BONDS KZP01Y03F543 (KZ2C00003945, FFINB2) OF FREEDOM FINANCE EXTENDED TILL JULY 17
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1342691/
Body: /KASE, July 14, 2017/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE or Exchange) Management Board the terms of subscription to indexed 
bonds KZP01Y03F543 (KZ2C00003945, KASE AIM, Bonds Category, FFINb2; 
KZT1,000, KZT5.0 bn; June 28, 2017 – June 28, 2020; semi-annual coupon 8.00 
% APR; 30/360) of Freedom Finance (Almaty) were extended until July 17, 2017 
inclusive.

This decision was taken by KASE Management Board based on item 7 of article 
2 of the Rules of conducting subscription to securities 
(http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/rules_ipo_eng.pdf) due to receipt by 
the Exchange of an official letter from Freedom Finance (Almaty) asking to move 
the buyer order acceptance end date from July 14 to 17, 2017.

According to the said letter the Seller shall receive the registry of orders
collected by the Exchange on July 18, 2017, the Exchange shall receive the
registry of orders executed by the Seller on July 19, 2017; the settlement date
is July 20, 2017.

The nominal value of the bonds to be placed is KZT one billion.

As the price an order must indicate the bonds' dirty price, expressed in tenge.

The number of financial instruments in an order must be represented by the 
number of bonds in pieces. The subscription conditions contain no buyer 
restrictions for a maximum number of bonds in the orders submitted.

The subscription orders will be collected on business days from 10:00 AM to 5:00
PM (Almaty time). The subscription bond ticker is FFINb2. For the subscription 
only the limit orders submitted to KASE trading system by the closed method will
be accepted.

The orders for participation are submitted only through KASE stock market 
members. The full list of KASE members by category is published at 
http://www.kase.kz/en/membership

According to this subscription terms the list of additional information on the 
investor disclosed to the issuer of the bonds must include the following data:

1) last name, first name, if available – patronymic or a legal entity name;

2) IIN of an individual or BIN of a legal entity;

3) name and details of a document confirming a personal identity / confirming 
   registration as a legal entity (number, issue date and issuing body);

4) address of an individual or a legal entity;

5) other information available in the accounting system of the Central
   Securities Depository not constituting a commercial secret in the securities
   market.

Details on the issue of shares are available on KASE website 
http://www.kase.kz/en/bonds/show/FFINb2

The Rules of Subscription to securities are available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/rules_ipo_eng.pdf

[2017-07-14]

Date: 2017-06-26
Title: As of June 26, 2017 securities of Kazinvestbank were delisted from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1340188/
Body: /KASE, June 26, 2017/ – Listing Commission of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) as of June 26, 2017 delisted the following securities of Kazinvestbank 
from KASE official list:

1) common shares KZ1C35620018 (KZ000A1CTMP5, KASE Main Market, 
   Standard Category, KIBN);

2) bonds KZP02Y15D789 (KZ2C00003184, KASE Main Market, Bonds 
   Category, KIBNb6);

3) bonds KZP03Y15D787 (KZ2C00003192, KASE Main Market, Bonds 
   Category, KIBNb7);

4) bonds KZ2C0Y15F392 (KZ2C00003770, KASE Main Market, Bonds 
   Category, KIBNb8).

According to KASE findings dated June 20, 2017 the possibility to delist these 
securities was considered due to a repeated (nine or more times during twelve 
consecutive calendar months) violation by Kazinvestbank of the disclosure 
requirements from KASE internal document "Listing rules".

In addition, KASE has no information whether the first coupon interest (for the 
period from September 19, 2016 to March 18, 2017) on bonds KZ2C0Y15F392, 
and the fourth coupon interest (for the period from November 19, 2016 to May 18,
2017) on bonds KZP02Y15D789 and KZP03Y15D787 were paid or not paid.

Based on the foregoing and in accordance with sub-item 6) of item 1 of Chapter 3
of Annex 2.2 to the Listing Rules, these securities were delisted.

Common shares were included in KASE official list’s "B" category on July 24, 
2003; as of June 1, 2017 they were in the "standard" category of KASE official
list. Trades in them opened on March 14, 2006.

Bonds KZP02Y15D789 and KZP03Y15D787 were included in KASE official list’s 
category "other debt securities" on May 19, 2015; as of June 1, 2017 they were
in the "bonds" category of the main market of KASE official list. Trades in
them opened on June 24, 2015

Bonds KZ2C0Y15F392 were included in KASE official list’s category "other debt 
securities" on September 19, 2016; as of June 1, 2017 they were in the "bonds" 
category of the main market of KASE official list. Trades in them opened on 
September 21, 2016

Management Board of KASE decided to suspend trading in these securities in 
KASE trading system as of December 28, 2016.

[2017-06-26]

Title: KASE OFFICIAL LIST’S SECURITIES ALLOCATION CHART ACCORDING TO NEW STRUCTURE APPROVED
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1336402/
Body: /KASE, May 26, 2017/ – The Listing Commission of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) approved the KASE official list’s securities allocation chart according
to the new structure on May 24, 2015.

The securities from the KASE official list were classified according to the
trading floor, sector and category, based on their compliance with the
Requirements for issuers and their securities admitted to circulation on the
exchange and certain categories of the exchange’s list and changes made to some
regulatory legal  acts of the Republic of Kazakhstan on securities market
regulation approved by  the Resolution No. 54 of the Management Board of the
National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan dated March 27, 2017, and
additional listing requirements established by the redrafted KASE internal
document "Listing  Rules". As previously reported, the above requirements and
the redrafted Listing Rules shall enter into force on June 1, 2017.

Based on the approved chart, the securities from the KASE official list shall be
allocated as follows as of June 1, 2017.

Main Market:

1)10 shares of eight issuers were included in the "Premium" category of the 
  "Shares" sector;

2)65 shares of 52 issuers were included in the "Standard" category of the 
  "Shares" sector;

3)240 bonds of 51 issuers were included in the "Bonds" category of the "Debt 
  securities" sector;

4)3 bonds of 3 issuers were included in the "Commercial bonds" category of 
  the "Debt securities" sector.

Alternative Investment Market:

1)44 shares of 41 issuers were included in the "Shares" sector;

2)18 bonds of 15 issuers were included in the "Bonds" category of the "Debt 
  securities" sector.

The securities that are now on KASE official list in the sectors "Securities of 
investment funds", "Securities of international financial organizations" and 
"Government securities" will be transferred to the relevant sectors of the Mixed
Market of KASE official list.

The chart is available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/mix/reclassification_listing_010617.pdf

The redrafted Listing Rules are available on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/listing_rules_new_010617.pdf

unfulfilled obligations in the securities market as of the said date are secured
by its assets. Therefore, the Bank’s default on its obligations will not have a
negative impact on other members of the Exchange.

In addition, the decision:

- suspended the Bank’s KASE membership, as the Exchange membership of 
  a participant shall be automatically suspended along with its suspension from 
  the exchange trading;

- as of April 26, 2016 KASE suspends the trading in the following Bank’s 
  securities in its trading system:

- common shares KZ1C36500011 (KZ000A1CTMT7, KASE official list,

KZIKb22;  KZT1, KZT10.0 bn; April 2, 2012 – April 2, 2017, semi-annual coupon
8.00 %  APR; 30/360) of Mortgage Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage Company
(Almaty)  due to expiration of their circulation term.

From April 3, 2017, when calculating the indexes KASE_BC, KASE_BP KASE will 
use the adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0007556.

From April 3, 2017, the representative list of indices KASE_B* will consist of 
bonds of 36 titles.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without 
account to accrued interest thereon (by "net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2017-04-03]

Date: 2016-10-28
Title: As of October 28 bonds KZP01Y07D747 (KZ2C00000420, IMSKb3) of Imstalcon removed from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1313267/
Body: /KASE, October 28, 2016/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Listing commission as of October 28, 2016 bonds KZP01Y07D747 (KZ2C00000420, 
KASE official list, category "buffer category", IMSKb3) of Imstalcon (Almaty) 
were removed from KASE official list.

In KASE's conclusion dated October 12, 2016 it is said that Imstalcon committed 
default on payment of interest for the 12th coupon period (from March 8 to 
September 7, 2016) on said bonds.

In accordance with sub-item 5) of item 26 of the Requirements for Issuers and 
their Securities (being) Admitted to Circulation on the Stock Exchange, as well 
as for Particular Categories of the Stock Exchange List approved by a resolution
No. 189 of the Management Board of National Bank of Republic of Kazakhstan 
dated October 22, 2014, securities of an issuer are subject to delisting in case
of default of the issuer on his obligations during the presence of his
securities in category "buffer category", if the issuer's Board of Directors
did not take a decision on restructuring the obligations

Based on the above-mentioned and in accordance with sub-item 2) of item 1 of 
article 19 of KASE internal document "Listing Rules" said bonds were removed 
from KASE official list

Said bonds were included in KASE official list's category "Rated Debt 
Securities" on September 8, 2010; on January 1, 2015 they were transferred to 
category "other debt securities" of KASE official list. On May 13, 2016 they
were transferred into "buffer category" of KASE official list. Trades in them
opened on November 11, 2010.

[2016-10-28]

Title: Bonds KZP01Y05F308 (KZ2P00003627, BUZAb1) of Buzgul Aurum underwent listing on KASE by "other debt securities" category
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1299698/
Body: /KASE, June 27, 2016/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Listing Commission of June 24, 2016, bonds KZP01Y05F308 
(KZ2P00003627; KZT10,000, KZT15.0 bn, 5 years, annual coupon 19.00 % p.a., 
30/360) of Buzgul Aurum (Almaty) were included in the "other debt securities" 
category of KASE official list.

The Listing Commission decision's effective date will be announced additionally 
as the named issuer fulfills the terms set in clause 1 of article 18 of KASE
internal document "Listing Rules".

Opening of KASE trading in these bonds will also be announced additionally.

The mentioned bond issue is the first one under the first bond program of Buzgul
Aurum registered by the National Bank of the Republic of Kazakhstan on June 8, 
2016 to the total amount of KZT30.0 bn, and the first issue of domestic bonds of
the mentioned issuer which underwent a listing procedure on KASE.

BCC Invest – subsidiary organization of Bank CenterCredit (Almaty) is the 
representative of holders of the said bonds.

Kazkommerts Securities (Subsidiary Organization of Kazkommertsbank) 
(Almaty) is the financial advisor and underwriter of Buzgul Aurum.

The said bonds were assigned an acronym (ticker) BUZAb1.

The main business activities of Buzgul Aurum include the development of gold 
ore fields in the Republic of Kazakhstan, mining, production and sale of gold
and Dore gold.

More detailed information on the said bond issue will be published on KASE 
website as the Listing Commission's decision becomes effective.

[2016-06-27]

Date: 2016-05-30
Title: KASE removes bonds KZP01Y05D980 (KZ2P00001548, APKIb4) of Corporation AIC-Invest from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1296944/
Body: /KASE, May 30, 2016/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) as of May 30, 2016 
removed from the representative list of indices of series KASE_B* bonds 
KZP01Y05D980 (KZ2P00001548, KASE official list, category "other debt 
securities", APKIb4; KZT1,000, KZT10.0 bn; May 30, 2011 – May 30, 2016; semi-
annual coupon 10.00 % APR; 30/360) of Corporation AIC-Invest (Astana), due 
to circulation term expiry.

From May 30, 2016, when calculating indexes KASE_BC, KASE_BP KASE will use the 
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0007477.

As of May 30, 2016 the representative list of indexes KASE_B* will consist of 
bonds of 55 titles.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net” 
prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

Earlier there was a related KASE news item of May 30, 2016 "Bonds KZP01Y05D980 
(KZ2P00001548, APKIb4) of Corporation AIC-Invest removed from KASE official list 
due to circulation term expiry" - http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1296884

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2016-05-30]

Title: As of May 13 Imstalcon bonds of three issues transferred from other debt securities category into buffer category of KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1295174/
Body: /KASE, May 13, 2016/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Listing Commission of May 12, 2016 the action for preventing the 
following bonds of Imstalcon (Astana, hereinafter – the company) from being 
transferred into the "buffer" category was accepted:

- KZP01Y07D549 (KZ2C00000412, KASE official list, category "other debt 
  securities", IMSKb1);

- KZP02Y07D547 (KZ2C00000446, KASE official list, category "other debt 
  securities", IIMSKb2);

- KZP01Y07D747 (KZ2C00000420, KASE official list, category "other debt 
  securities", IMSKb3).

In KASE conclusion of May 12, 2016 it is said that in March 2016 the company 
committed default on paying interest due for the 11-th coupon period (from 
September 8, 2015 to March 7, 2016) on bonds IMSKb3, in April 2016 – on 
payment of interest for the 13-th coupon period (from October 8, 2015 to
April 7, 2016) on bonds IMSKb2.

In accordance with sub-item 1) of item 14 of the Requirements for issuers and 
their securities (being) admitted to circulation on the stock exchange, as well
as for particular categories of the stock exchange list approved by a
resolution of  the National Bank of Republic of Kazakhstan of October 22, 2014,
a default of  an issuer on payment of interest on its liabilities (except for
interest for the final  coupon period) is a reason for transfer of its debt
securities into category "buffer  category" of KASE official list.

In accordance with item 18 of said Requirements the company  provided KASE 
on May 11, 2016 with an action plan for preventing a transfer of its securities 
into the "buffer" category of KASE official list.

In accordance with paragraph two of item 20 of said Requirements as of May 13, 
2016 said bonds were transferred into the  "buffer" category of KASE official
list.

[2016-05-13]

Date: 2016-02-22
Title: KASE removes bonds KZ2C0Y10E396 (KZ2C00001956, GLDCb1) of Golden Compass Capital from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to suspension of trades
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1287810/
Body: /KASE, February 22, 16/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on Indices
and Securities Valuation as of February 22, 2016 removed from the representative 
list of indices KASE_B* bonds KZ2C0Y10E396 (KZ2C00001956, KASE official list, 
category "other debt securities", GLDCb1; KZT1, KZT8.0 bn; January 10, 2013 – 
January 10, 2023, annual coupon 12.00 % APR, 30/360) of Golden Compass Capital 
JSC (Almaty) due to the suspension of trading in them.

From February 22, 2016, when calculating the indexes KASE_BC, KASE_BP KASE will
use the adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0007426.

From February 22, 2016 the representative list of indices KASE_B* will consist 
of bonds of 56 titles.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without
account to accrued interest thereon (by "net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

Earlier there was a related KASE news item of February 22, 2016 "As of 
February 22 trading in bonds KZ2C0Y10E396 (KZ2C00001956, GLDCb1) of Golden 
Compass Capital suspended on KASE" at http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1287759

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by KASE internal document 
"Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2016-02-22]

Body: /KASE, September 18, 15/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Listing Commission of September 17, 2015 the action plan on removal of 
reasons for transfer into category "buffer category" of KASE official list of 
bonds KZ2C0Y23B676 (KZ2C00000701, DTJLb1; KZT1,000, KZT30.0 bn; August 2, 2005 – 
August 2, 2028, annual coupon indexed at inflation rate, 4.75 % APR for the 
current coupon period, 30/360) of Doszhan Temir Zholy (DTZ) JSC (Almaty).

In KASE's conclusion of September 9, 2015 it is said that in August 2015 
Doszhan Temir Zholy (DTZ) JSC committed partial default on payment of interest 
for the tenth coupon period (from August 2, 2015 to August 1, 2015) on the 
mentioned bonds.

In accordance with sub-item 1) of item 14 of the Requirements for issuers and 
their securities (being) submitted to circulation on the stock exchange, as well
as for particular categories of the stock exchange approved by Resolution of the
National Bank of Republic of Kazakhstan of October 22, 2014, default of an 
issuer on payment of interest on his obligations (except for the interest for
the last coupon period) is a reason for transfer of his securities into
category "buffer  category" of KASE official list.

In accordance with item 18 of the said Requirements Doszhan Temir Zholy (DTZ) 
JSC on September 7, 2015 provided KASE with an action plan on removal of reasons 
for transfer of his securities into category "buffer category" of  KASE official 
list.

In accordance with item 20, paragraph two of the said Requirements as of 
September 18, 2015 the mentioned bonds were transferred into category "buffer 
category" of KASE official list.

Title: Bonds KZP03Y07C612 (KZ2C00001196, EUBNb6) of Eurasian Bank removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1268217/
Body: /KASE, September 1, 15/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) informs that as 
of September 1, 2015 bonds KZP03Y07C612 (KZ2C00001196, KASE official 
list, category "other debt securities", EUBNb6; KZT100, KZT5.0 bn; September 1, 
2008 – September 1, 2015; semi-annual coupon 11.00 % APR, 30/360) of 
Eurasian Bank JSC (Almaty) were removed from KASE official list due to the 
circulation term expiry.

The mentioned bonds were included in the "A" category on August 29, 2008; on 
September 1, 2008 they were transferred to the first sub-category of KASE 
official list's category "Non-Rated Debt Securities"; on June 15, 2011 – to 
category "Rated Debt Securities"; on January 1, 2015 – to "other debt
securities"  category of KASE official list. Trades in them opened on October
25, 2012.

During these bonds' circulation on KASE their yield to maturity for buyer (on 
deals made by open trades methods) varied from 8.00 to 16.00 % APR.

[2015-09-01]

Title: As of April 16 bonds KZ2C0Y23B676 (KZ2C00000701, DTJLb1) of Doszhan Temir Zholy (DTZ) transferred from buffer category into Other Debt Securities category of KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1251581/
Body: /KASE, April 16, 15/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Listing Commission as of April 16, 2014 bonds KZ2C0Y23B676 
(KZ2C00000701, DTJLb1; KZT1,000, KZT30.0 bn; August 2, 2005 – August 2, 
2028, annual coupon, 7.35 % p.a. for the current coupon period, 30/360) of 
Doszhan Temir Zholy JSC (DTZ) (Ust-Kamenogorsk) are transferred from 
category "buffer category" into Other Debt Securities category of KASE official 
list.

In KASE conclusion of April 9, 2015 it is said the reason for the transfer of
the  mentioned bonds into the buffer category of KASE official list was the
default  committed by Doszhan Temir Zholy JSC (DTZ) on payment of interest on
the  mentioned bonds for the ninth coupon period (from August 2, 2013 to August
1,  2014).

Due to removal by Doszhan Temir Zholy JSC (DTZ) of reasons for transfer of 
the mentioned bonds into the buffer category and fulfillment of all requirements
to  Issuers and their securities admitted to circulation on the Exchange as well
as  certain categories of the stock exchange list, approved by the Resolution of
the  Management Board of the National Bank of Kazakhstan dated October 22, 2014 
No. 189 and required to be complied with in order to transfer these bonds to 
"other debt securities" category, additional requirements established by the 
internal document of KASE "Listing Rules" in accordance with clause 24 of the 
said requirements, these bonds were transferred to "other debt securities" 
category of KASE official list.

The mentioned bonds were included in category A of KASE official list as of 
August 7, 2006, and from September 1, 2008 they were transferred into the 
second sub-category of Non-Rated Debt Securities category, and from October 
10, 2014 – to buffer category. Trade in them opened as of August 23, 2006.

[2015-04-16]

the stock exchange, as well as for particular categories of the stock exchange 
list, approved by Resolution No. 189 of Management Board of the National Bank 
of Republic of Kazakhstan dated October 22, 2014 and mandatory for transfer of 
the mentioned bonds into the "other debt securities" category in accordance 
with item 24 of the mentioned requirements the mentioned bonds were transferred 
into the "other debt securities" category of KASE official list.

The mentioned bonds were included in the Rated Debt Securities category of 
KASE official list as of July 18, 2011; as of March 12, 2014 they were 
transferred into the "buffer category". Trades in them were opened as of
October 17, 2011.

Body: /KASE, January 21, 15/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange 
(KASE) Management Board as of January 22, 2015 trades in bonds KZP01Y05E608 
(KZ2C00002509, KASE official list, category "other debt securities", ATFBb9) of 
ATFBank JSC (Almaty) will be suspended on KASE.

This decision was taken in accordance with item 6 of article 18-2 of the Act of 
Republic of Kazakhstan "On Securities Market".

Trading will be suspended until receipt by KASE of information on publication 
of a decision of the general meeting of holders of the said bonds of January 22,
2015.

Earlier, there was a related KASE news item of December 29, 2014 "General 
meeting of holders of bonds KZP01Y05E608 (KZ2C00002509, ATFBb9) of ATFBank

Date: 2014-07-11
Title: As of July 11 bonds KZ2C0Y07D923 (KZ2C00000222, CAHOb1) of Manhattan Residence excluded from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1224608/
Body: /KASE, July 11, 14/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) 
Listing Commission as of July 11, 2014 bonds KZ2C0Y07D923 (KZ2C00000222, KASE 
official list, Rated Debt Securities category, CAHOb1; KZT1,000, KZT1.2 bn; 
June 6, 2011 – June 6, 2018, semi-annual coupon 9.00 % APR; 30/360) of Manhattan 
Residence JSC (Almaty) were excluded from KASE official list.

In KASE conclusion of July 1, 2014 it is said that based on results of the check
of Manhattan Residence JSC and its mentioned bonds for compliance with the  
Requirements for issuers whose securities are supposed to be included or have 
been included in the list of the special trading platform of  the regional
financial center of Almaty, as well as for such securities approved by Order
04.2-09/119 of the Chairman of Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan on 
Regulation of Activities of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty dated 
May 8, 2008, for the Rated Debt Securities category, incompliance of Manhattan
Residence and its bonds with the listing requirements for the rating was
detected.

By letter of March 13, 2014 Manhattan Residence notified KASE of withdrawal by 
Rating agency "KZ-rating" of the rating on the mentioned bonds due to expiry of 
the validity of the agreement concluded with the said rating agency.

According to sub-item 1) of item 8 of the mentioned Requirements, as well as 
sub-item 2) of item 1 of Order No. 6 of the Chairman of Agency of the Republic 
of Kazakhstan on Regulation of Activities of the Regional Financial Center of 
Almaty "On Setting requirements for ratings of securities and their issuers for 
admittance to the special trading floor of Regional Financial Center of Almaty" 
dated September 8, 2006 the minimum rating of debt securities must be at least 
"Сaa3" according to classification of rating agency Moody's Investors Service, 
"СCC-" according to rating agencies Standard & Poor's and Fitch Ratings, "С1" 
according to classification of rating agency of Regional Financial Center of 
Almaty, "С++" according to classification of rating agency Expert RA Kazakhstan 
and "ССС" according to classification of Rating agency "KZ-rating".

Until now KASE has no information on assignment to the said bonds of a rating.

Based on the above-mentioned and in accordance with sub-item 2) of item 1 of 
article 19 of KASE internal document "Listing Rules" the mentioned bonds were 
delisted.

The mentioned bonds were included in KASE official list's Rated Debt Securities 
category from June 6, 2011. Trades in them were opened on September 5, 2011.

During these bonds' circulation on KASE their yield to maturity for buyer (on 
deals made by open trades methods) varied from 5.00 to 16.00 % APR.

[2014-07-11]

Almatyenergosbyt LLP into the buffer category of KASE official list was 
accepted.

In KASE conclusion of June 18, 2014 it is said that based on results of a check

for issuers whose securities are supposed to be included or have been included 
in the list of the special trading platform of  the regional financial center of
Almaty, as well as for such securities approved by Order 04.2-09/119 of the 
Chairman of Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation of Activities 
of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty dated May 8, 2008, for the second 
sub-category of Non-Rated Debt Securities category, incompliance of 
Almatyenergosbyt and its bonds with the listing requirement for the equity 
amount was detected.

According to Almatyenergosbyt financial statements for 2013 confirmed by an 
auditor's report Almatyenergosbyt's equity as of December 31, 2013 made up a 
negative amount (KZT-215,861 th.).

In accordance with sub-item 1) of item 13-1 of the said requirements an 
incompliance of debt securities and their issuer with requirements specified by 
items 10 and 11 of the Requirements is enough for transfer of the debt 
securities into the buffer category of KASE official list.

In accordance with sub-item 2) item 13-1, paragraph two of item 13-7 and item 
13-11 of the said Requirements the issue of approval of the said decision of the
Listing commission will be considered at a meeting of KASE Board of Directors.
