Date: 2014-06-09
Title: As of June 9 bonds KZ2C0Y06D750 (KZ2C00001683, TEMAb2) of TEMA Ko. excluded from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1222180/
Body: /KASE, June 9, 14/ – Following a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) 
Listing Commission as of June 9, 2014 bonds KZ2C0Y06D750 (KZ2C00001683, KASE 
official list, rated Debt Securities category, TEMAb2; KZT1,000, KZT1.2 bn;
May 14, 2010 – May 14, 2016, quarterly coupon 13.50 % APR; 30/360) of TEMA Ko. 
(Almaty) were excluded from KASE official list.

In KASE conclusion of June 2, 2014 it is said, that in February 2014 default was
committed on these bonds with regard to payment of the 15-th coupon interest 
(from November 14, 2013 to February 13, 2014), with Rating agency of Regional 
Financial Center of Almaty on March 4, 2014 downgrading the rating assigned to 
the mentioned bonds from "С1" to "D".

In accordance with sub-item 2) of item 1of Order No. 6 of the Chairman of Agency
of the Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation of Activities of the Regional
Financial Center of Almaty "On Setting requirements for ratings of securities
and their issuers for admittance to the special trading floor of Regional
Financial Center of Almaty" dated September 8, 2006 the minimum rating of debt
securities must be at least "Сaa3" according to classification of rating agency
Moody's Investors  Service, "СCC-" according to rating agencies Standard &
Poor's and Fitch Ratings, "С1" according to classification of rating agency of
Regional Financial Center of Almaty, "С++" according to classification of
rating agency Expert RA Kazakhstan  and "ССС" according to classification of
Rating agency "KZ-rating".

In the said conclusion it is also said that TEMA Ko. fails to meet requirements
for information disclosure set by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan, 
KASE  internal document KASE "Listing Rules" and agreement on listing of 
corporate  serial securities dated August 18, 2010 concluded between TEMA Ko. 
and KASE.

According to sub-item 2) of item 1 of article 19 of KASE internal document
"Listing Rules" in case the issuer and his bonds fail to meet requirements for
the rating and  sub-item 5) item 1 of article 19 of KASE internal document
"Listing Rules" in case  of a systematic (more than three times within twelve
consecutive months) non- compliance of the securities admittance initiator with
requirements for information  disclosure specified by the legislation of the
Republic of Kazakhstan, Listing Rules  and listing agreement, the mentioned
bonds are subject to delisting.

KASE does not currently possess any information on the rating review, as well as
on payment of interest on the mentioned bonds for the sixteenth coupon period 
(from February 14 to May 13, 2014).

Based on the above-mentioned the bonds of TEMA Ko. were delisted.

The mentioned bonds were included in KASE official list's Rated Debt Securities 
category from August 23, 2010. Trades in them were opened on September 17, 2010. 
During their circulation on KASE no deals were made involving them.

[2014-06-09]

Date: 2014-04-03
Title: KASE removed bonds of two issues from KASE_B* series indices representative list bonds KZP05Y07C112 (KZ2C00000859, BTAIb14) of BTA Bank Subsidiary BTA Ipoteka due to their circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1216202/
Body: /KASE, April 3, 14/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on Indices 
and Securities Valuation removed from April 3, 2013 the following bonds from 
the representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds 
KZP05Y07C112 (KZ2C00000859, KASE official list Non-rated Debt Securities 
second subcategory, BTAIb14; KZT100, KZT10.0 bn; April 3, 07 – April 3, 14; 
semi-annual coupon indexed at inflation rate, 5.90 % APR for the reporting 
coupon period; 30/360) of BTA Bank Subsidiary BTA Ipoteka (Almaty) due to 
their circulation term expiry.

From April 3, 2014, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the 
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9938179, when calculating KASE_BC – 
0.9925303, KASE_BY – 1.6814376. Before the mentioned date (К) for 
KASE_BP equaled to 0.9938176, KASE_BC – 0.9925292 and 1.6814367 for 
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of April 3, 2014 "Bonds KZP05Y07C112 
(KZ2C00000859, BTAIb14) of Subsidiary organization of BTA Bank joint-stock 
company BTA Ipoteka (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list due to 
circulation term expiry" - http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1216150

The Methodology of Indices calculation is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Stock Market Indicators Calculation", available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2014-04-03]

Date: 2013-12-24
Title: KASE removed bonds KZ2P0Y07C187 (KZ2C00000644, RESCb1) of RESMI Group from KASE_B* series indices representative list due to their circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1209296/
Body: /KASE, December 24, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on 
Indices and Securities Valuation informs that from December 23, 2013 bonds 
KZ2P0Y07C187 (KZ2C00000644, KASE official list Non-rated Debt Securities 
first subcategory, RESCb1; KZT10, KZT12.0 bn, December 21, 06 – December 
21, 13; semi-annual coupon 12.00 % APR; 30/360) of RESMI Group (Almaty) 
have been removed from the representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP 
and KASE_BC due to circulation term expiry.

From December 24, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use 
the adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0002769, when calculating 
KASE_BC – 1.0017085, KASE_BY – 1.6820610. Before the mentioned date (К) 
for KASE_BP equaled to 1.0004163, KASE_BC – 1.0018480 and 1.6820707 for 
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of December 23, 2013 "Bonds KZ2P0Y07C187 
(KZ2C00000644, RESCb1) of RESMI Group removed from KASE official list 
due to circulation term expiry" on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1209160

The Methodology of Indices calculation is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Stock Market Indicators Calculation", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2013-12-24]

Date: 2013-11-12
Title: KASE removed bonds KZPC1Y07C299 (KZ2C00000735, EXBNb1) of Eximbank Kazakhstan from KASE_B* series indices representative list due to their circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1205985/
Body: /KASE, November 12, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) informs that 
from November 12, 2013 from the representative list of indices KASE_BY, 
KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds KZPC1Y07C299 (KZ2C00000735, KASE official list 
Non-rated Debt Securities first subcategory, EXBNb1; KZT100, KZT10.0 bn; 
November 12, 06 – November 12, 13; semi-annual coupon 9.00 % APR; 30/360) 
of Eximbank Kazakhstan (Almaty) have been removed from KASE official list 
due to circulation term expiry.

From November 12, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will 
use the adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0004163, when calculating 
KASE_BC – 1.0018480, KASE_BY – 1.6820707. Before the mentioned date (К) 
for KASE_BP equaled to 1.0004578, KASE_BC – 1.0018980 and 1.6820699 for 
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net” 
prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to  fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds
in  accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of November 12, 2013 "Bonds 
KZPC1Y07C299 (KZ2C00000735, EXBNb1) of Eximbank Kazakhstan removed 
from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry" on KASE website at 
http://www.kase.kz/news/show/1205936

The Methodology of Indices calculation is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Stock Market Indicators Calculation", available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2013-11-12]

Date: 2013-10-01
Title: KASE removed bonds KZ2C0Y10A857 (KZ000A0TZW69, KZIKb2) of Mortgage Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage Company from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to their circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1202344/
Body: /KASE, October 1, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on Indices 
and Securities Valuation from October 1, 2013 from the representative list of 
indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds KZ2C0Y10A857 (KZ000A0TZW69, KASE 
official list Rated Debt Securities category, KZIKb2; KZT1, KZT3.0 bn; 
August 11, 03 – October 1, 13; semi-annual coupon indexed at inflation 
rate, 7.60 % APR for the last coupon period; 30/360) of Mortgage 
Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage Company (Almaty) have been removed 
from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry.

From October 1, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the 
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0004698, when calculating KASE_BC – 
1.0019143, KASE_BY – 1.6820841. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP 
equaled to 1.0004364, KASE_BC – 1.0006503 and 1.6820841 for KASE_BY, 
accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to  fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds
in  accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of October 1, 2013 "Bonds KZ2C0Y10A857 
(KZ000A0TZW69, KZIKb2) of Mortgage Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage 
Company (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list due to circulation 
term expiry" at http://mirror.kase.kz/en/news/show/1202326

The Methodology of Indices calculation is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Stock Market Indicators Calculation", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2013-10-01]

Title: KASE removed bonds KZP02Y08B648 (KZ2C00000883, BTAIb8) of BTA Bank Subsidiary BTA Ipoteka from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to their circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1199750/
Body: /KASE, August 22, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on Indices 
and Securities Valuation from August 22, 2013 removed from the representative 
list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds KZP02Y08B648 (KASE official 
list Non-rated Debt Securities second subcategory, BTAIb8; KZT100, KZT7.0 bn; 
August 22, 05 – August 22, 13; semi-annual coupon indexed at inflation rate, 
7.10 % APR for the last coupon period; 30/360) of BTA Bank Subsidiary 
BTA Ipoteka (Almaty) due to circulation term expiry.

From August 22, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the 
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0004698, when calculating KASE_BC – 
1.0019143, KASE_BY – 1.6820841. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP 
equaled to 1.0004364, KASE_BC – 1.0006503 and 1.6820763 for KASE_BY, 
accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of August 22, 2013 "Bonds KZP02Y08B648 
(KZ2C00000883, BTAIb8) of BTA Bank Subsidiary BTA Ipoteka (Kazakhstan) 
removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry" по адресу 
http://www.kase.kz/news/show/1199688

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Admitted to the Official list of Special Trading Floor of the Regional Financial
Center of Almaty, and for Such Securities" of May 8, 2008 # 04.2-09/119 and 
required for transfer of the said bonds into the second sub-category of the
"Non-Rated Debt Securities" category, in accordance with item 13-12 of the
mentioned Appendix the said bonds have been moved from the "buffer category"
into the second sub-category of KASE official list's "Non-Rated Debt Securities" 
category.

The said bonds were included in the "B" category of KASE official list as of
March 11, 2008; from September 1, 2008 they were transferred into the second

  "KazTransOil" – not lower than KZT750 per share with the upper limit  of the

Date: 2013-05-31
Title: As of June 3 bonds KZ2C0Y08B834 (KZ2C00001014, TKUDb1) of Ore mining and processing enterprise Tort-Kudyk (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1193272/
Body: /KASE, May 31, 13/ – Following  a decision of Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) 
Listing Commission, as of June 3, 2013 bonds KZ2C0Y08B834 (KZ2C00001014, TKUDb1; 
KZT1,000, KZT2.0 bn; November 3, 2006 – November 3, 2014, semi-annual coupon 
indexed at inflation rate, 9.40 % per annum for the current coupon period, 
30/360) of JSC "Ore mining and processing enterprise Tort-Kudyk" (Astana) were 
removed from KASE official list.

In KASE's May 30, 2013 summary it is noted that a default was committed on 
payment of the 13th coupon interest on the mentioned bonds (from November 3, 
2012 to May 2, 2013). According to sub-item 5) item 13-16 of Appendix No. 04.2-
09/119 to the Order of the Chairman of Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan on 
regulation of Activities of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty "On Setting 
out of requirements for issuers whose securities are supposed to be included or 
have been included in the list of the special trading platform of the regional 
financial center of Almaty, as well as for such securities" dated May 8, 2008, 
in case an issuer committed a default on his liabilities while his securities  
were in the "buffer" category, and the issuer's Board of Directors failed to 
take a  decision to restructure his liabilities, such securities are subject to 
delisting.

Currently, KASE does not possess any information whether the Board of Directors 
of Ore mining and processing enterprise Tort-Kudyk took a decision to 
restructure its liabilities.

Based on the above-mentioned, the mentioned bonds were removed from the 
official list.

The mentioned bonds were included in category B of KASE official list as of 
November 3, 2006, and from September 1, 2008 they were transferred into the 
second sub-category of Non-Rated Debt Securities category of KASE official list.
From December 27, 2012 they were transferred into KASE official list's buffer 
category. Trade in them opened as of January 31, 2008.

During their circulation on KASE their yield to maturity for buyer (on deals 
concluded by the open trade method) varied from 0.51 to 25.00 % per annum.

[2013-05-31]

Body: /KASE, March 14, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on 
Indices and Securities valuation removed from May 28, 2013 from the 
representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds 
KZ2C0Y05C747 (KZ2C00000289, KASE official list Non-rated Debt Securities 
second subcategory, REALb1; KZT1, KZT5.0 bn; May 30, 08 – May 30, 13, 
semi-annual coupon indexed at inflation rate, 10.00 % APR for the current 
coupon period; 30/360) of Financial Company REAL-INVEST.kz (Almaty) due 
to suspension of trades in these bonds.

From March 28, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the 
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9872918, when calculating KASE_BC – 
0.9822401, KASE_BY – 1.6177417. Before the mentioned date (К) for 
KASE_BP equaled to 0.9872911, KASE_BC – 0.9822392 and 1.6175659 for 
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon 
(by "net” prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to  fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds
in  accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of May 28, 2013 "KASE extends suspension 
of trading in bonds KZ2C0Y05C747 (KZ2C00000289, REALb1) of Financial 
company REAL-INVEST.kz (Kazakhstan)" по адресу 
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1192715

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2013-05-30]

Date: 2013-04-15
Title: KASE included to KASE_B* series indices representative list bonds KZ2P0Y10C900 (KZ2P00000193, ORDKb2) of Credit Association ORDA Credit (Kazakhstan)
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1189248/
Body: /KASE, April 15, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on 
Indices and Securities valuation from April 15, 2013 included in the 
representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds 
KZ2P0Y10C900 (KASE official list Rated Debt Securities category, ORDKb2; 
KZT1,000, KZT1.5 bn, January 26, 08 – January 26, 18; quarterly coupon, 
12.00 % APR; 30/360) of Credit Association ORDA Credit (Shymkent), the 
number of offered bonds – 1,500,000 units.

The restrictive coefficient on bonds included the representative list of 
indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP и KASE_BC also equals to one.

From April 15, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the 
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9873140, when calculating KASE_BC – 
0.9822692, KASE_BY – 1.6176160. Before the mentioned date (К) for 
KASE_BP equaled to 0.9873165, KASE_BC – 0.9822735 and 1.6147563 for 
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY – corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC – corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices 
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" 
prices).

KASE_BP – corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued 
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to 
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited
to  f
ifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds in 
accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The 
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal 
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2013-04-15]

Title: Special trading session to place bonds KZ2C0Y07E152 (KZ2C00001691, PRKRb5) of National Company Food Contract Corporation (Kazakhstan) will be held on KASE April 1
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1187055/
Body: /KASE, March 18, 13/ – Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) informs that on 
April 1, 2013 the special trading session will be held in KASE trading 
system to place bonds KZ2C0Y07E152 (KZ2C00001691, KASE official list, 
Rated Debt Securities category, PRKRb5; KZT1,000, KZT40.0 bn; December 12, 
11 – December 12, 18; semi-annual coupon 7.50 % APR; 30/360) of National 
Company Food Contract Corporation (Astana).

BTA Securities - Subsidiary of BTA Bank (Almaty) will act as the seller at 
special trades.

The declared volume of placement is 5,000,000 bonds KZ2C0Y07E152 
(12.5 % from the total number of registered bonds of this issue).

The special trades will be held in KASE trading system from 11:30 a.m. to 
03:00 p.m. (Almaty time) (ALT). The security ticker at the trading session – 
PRKRb5. The issuer shall define a cut-off till 04:00 a.m. ALT on the day of 
trades.

Settlements will be made by the Central Securities Depository in compliance 
with its rules. The buyer of securities must ensure the availability of money 
payable for securities bought at a correspondent account in the Central 
Securities Depository at 04:00 p.m. ALT (Т+0).

Only limited orders submitted to the KASE trading system by the closed 
method will be accepted.

As the price an order will indicate the bonds’ "net" price (excluding interest 
accrued) expressed as percentage of the security face value accurate within 
the fourth decimal. The number of financial instruments in an order must be 
equal to the number of bonds in units. As the volume orders must quote the 
production of the bonds’ number, indicated in an order and the "dirty" price 
per bond (including interest accrued). A deal’s volume is calculated in 
compliance with article 14 of chapter 3 of the Methodology of Bonds Yield 
Calculation and Amount of Deals in Bonds available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/bond_yield_eng.pdf

The method of acceptance of orders for purchase – at prices of orders equal 
to the cut-off price or being more favorable for the seller.

Only KASE stock market members may submit application for participation in 
the trades. Other investors can submit orders through those legal entities.

The full list of stock market members is available at 
http://www.kase.kz/en/membership

The mentioned bonds issue prospectus is available at 
http://www.kase.kz/files/emitters/PRKR/prkrf9b5_2011.pdf

[2013-03-18]

Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1186206/
Body: /KASE, February 28, 13/ – By Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Listing 
Commission decision from March 1, 2013 bonds KZ2P0Y07D045 (KZ2P00001266, AESOb1; 
KZT1, KZT900.0 m, July 2, 2008 – July 2, 2015; semi-annual coupon 15.00 %; 
30/360) of LLP "Almatyenergosbyt" (Almaty) were transferred from KASE official 
list’s "buffer category" into the second sub-category of "Non-Rated Debt 
Securities" category.

In a KASE conclusion of February 22, 2013 it is mentioned that the reason for 
the transfer of the mentioned bonds into KASE official list's "buffer category" 
was the incompliance  of LLP "Almatyenergosbyt" with the listing requirement 
for equity.

Due to the fact that LLP "Almatyenergosbyt" has removed reasons for the 
transfer of the said bonds into the "buffer category" and fulfilled all the 
requirements set forth by Appendix to Order of Chairman of the Agency of the 
Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation of Activities of the Regional Financial 
Center of Almaty "On Setting Requirements for Issuers, Whose Securities 
Admissible or Admitted to the Official list of Special Trading Floor of the 
Regional Financial Center of Almaty, and for Such Securities" of May 8, 2008 
# 04.2-09/119 and required for transfer of the said bonds into the second sub-
category of the "Non-Rated Debt Securities" category, in accordance with item 
13-12 of the mentioned Appendix the said bonds have been moved from the 
"buffer category" into the second sub-category of KASE official list’s
"Non-Rated Debt Securities" category.

The said bonds were included into the second sub-category of the "Non-Rated 
Debt Securities" category of the official list of the special trading floor of
the  regional financial center of Almaty as of November 9, 2009. Trading in them
was opened on November 9, 2009.

Title: KASE removed bonds KZPC4Y05B661 (KZ2C00001139, MREKb5) of Mangistau Electricity Distribution Network Company (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices representative list due to their circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1185128/
Body: /KASE, February 12, 13/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on
Indices and Securities Valuation removed from February 12, 2013 from the
representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds
KZPC4Y05B661 (KZ2C00001139, KASE official list, Rated Debt Securities
category, MREKb5; KZT1, KZT800.0 m.; February 12, 08 - February 12, 13,
semi-annual coupon 16.00 % APR; 30/360) of Mangistau Electricity
Distribution Network Company (Aktau) due to their circulation term 
expiry.

From February 12, 2013, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use
the adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9870799, when calculating
KASE_BC - 0.9820374, KASE_BY - 1.6126816. Before the mentioned date (К)
for KASE_BP equaled to 0.9870919, KASE_BC - 0.9820518 and 1.6126825 for
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is 
limited to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not 
redeemed bonds in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be 
accounted. The limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of February 12, 2013 "Bonds
KZPC4Y05B661 (KZ2C00001139, MREKb5) of Mangistau Electricity
Distribution Network Company (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list
due to circulation term expiry" at http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1185103

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Date: 2012-12-04
Title: KASE removed bonds KZP03Y05C491 (KZ2C00001063, KZIKb18) of Mortgage Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage Company (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices representative list due to circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1180238/
Body: /KASE, December 4, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on
Indices and Securities Valuation from December 4, 2012 removed from KASE_BY, 
KASE_BP and KASE_BC indices representative list bonds KZP03Y05C491 
(KZ2C00001063, KASE official list Rated Debt Securities category, KZIKb18; 
KZT1, KZT5.0 bn, December 1, 07 - December 1, 12; semi-annual coupon 
11.00 % APR; 30/360) of Mortgage Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage Company 
(Almaty) due to circulation term expiry.

From December 4, 2012, when calculating index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9963752, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9961162, KASE_BY - 1.6136220. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP 
equaled to 0.9988325, KASE_BC - 0.9991187 and 1.6131400 for KASE_BY, 
accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without 
account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited 
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds 
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Earlier KASE published news of December 4, 2012 "Bonds KZP03Y05C491 (KZ2C00001063, 
KZIKb18) of Mortgage Organization Kazakhstan Mortgage Company removed from KASE 
official list due to circulation term expiry" at 
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1180172 

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2012-12-04]

Title: KASE removes bonds KZ2C0Y05C622 (KZ2C00001147, ZERDb1) of Mineral Resources of Central Asia (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to their removal from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1177633/
Body: /KASE, October 31, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on
Indices and Securities valuation from October 31, 2012 removed from the
representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds
KZ2C0Y05C622 (KZ2C00001147, KASE official list, Rated Debt Securities,
ZERDb1; KZT1,000, KZT5.0 bn, December 28, 2007 - December 28, 2012; semi-
annual coupon 10.00 % APR; 30/360) of JSC "Mineral Resources of Central
Asia" (Almaty) due to their removal from KASE official list.

From October 31, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9988325, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9991187, KASE_BY - 1.6131400. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP
equaled to 0.9990690, KASE_BC - 0.9993080 and 1.6121530 for KASE_BY,
accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without
account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited to
fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds in
accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

bonds KZ2C0Y05C622 (KZ2C00001147, ZERDb1) of Mineral Resources of
Central Asia (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list" at
http://www.kase.kz/news/show/1177580

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Date: 2012-10-30
Title: From October 31 bonds KZ2C0Y05C622 (KZ2C00001147, ZERDb1) of Mineral Resources of Central Asia (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1177580/
Body: /KASE, October 30, 12/ - By Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Listing
Commission decision, from October 31, 2012 bonds KZ2C0Y05C622
(KZ2C00001147, KASE official list, Rated Debt Securities, ZERDb1; KZT1,000,
KZT5.0 bn, December 28, 2007 - December 28, 2012; semi-annual coupon
10.00 % APR; 30/360) of JSC "Mineral Resources of Central Asia" (Almaty)
were removed from KASE official list.

In KASE conclusion of October 24, 2012 it is noted that based on results of a
check of JSC "Mineral Resources of Central Asia" and its mentioned bonds for
compliance with the listing requirements, set forth by Appendix to Order # 04.2-
09/119 of Chairman of the Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation
of Activities of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty "On Setting Requirements
for Issuers, Whose Securities Admissible or Admitted to the Official list of
Special Trading Floor of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty, and for Such
Securities" of May 8, 2008 for the Rated Debt Securities category, incompliance of
the mentioned bonds with the listing requirement for the availability of a
market-maker was detected. Since September 13, 2012 there has been no market-maker
for the mentioned bonds, which does not comply with the listing requirement, set
forth by sub-item 7) of item 8 of the said Appendix.

Based on the above-mentioned and in accordance with sub-item 2) item 1 article
19 of KASE internal document "Listing Rules", the said bonds were de-listed.

The said bonds were included into the "B" category of KASE official list from
December 28, 2007; from March 28, 2008 they were transferred into the "A"
category of KASE official list; from September 1, 2008 - into the second sub-
category of Rated Debt Securities; and from July 22, 2010 - into rated Debt
Securities category of KASE official list. Trading in them was opened from
December 29, 2007.

During the circulation term of the mentioned bonds at KASE their yield to maturity
for buyer (on completed deals concluded by open trade method) varied from 5.00
to 119.00 % APR.

Date: 2012-09-27
Title: KASE removes bonds KZ2CKY07B717 (KZ2C00000321, NFBNb1) of Delta Bank (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1175114/
Body: /KASE, September 27, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on
Indices and Securities valuation from September 27, 2012 removed from the
representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds
KZ2CKY07B717 (KZ2C00000321, KASE official list, second sub-category of
Non-Rated Debt Securities category, NFBNb1; KZT100, KZT3.0 bn; September
27, 2005 - September 27, 2012; semi-annual coupon indexed at inflation rate,
7.90 % APR for the final coupon period; 30/360) of JSC "Delta Bank" (Almaty)
due to circulation term expiry.

From August 10, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9990609, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9992983, KASE_BY - 1.6108719. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP
equaled to 0.9985228, KASE_BC - 0.9984929 and 1.6124415 for KASE_BY,
accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without
account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited to
fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds in
accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Earlier there was a piece of KASE news of September 27, 2012 "Bonds
KZ2CKY07B717 (KZ2C00000321, NFBNb1) of Delta Bank (Kazakhstan)
removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry"
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1175095

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2012-09-27]

Date: 2012-08-27
Title: /REPETITION/ From August 27 bonds KZ2C0Y19C805 (KZ2C00000743, ABDIb1) of ABDI Company (Kazakhstan) will be excluded from KASE official list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1173190/
Body: /KASE, August 27, 12, August 22, 12 news repetition/ - Following a decision of
Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Listing Commission, from August 27, 2012
bonds KZ2C0Y19C805 (KZ2C00000743, ABDIb1; KZT10,000, KZT9.0 bn,
January 8, 2008 - January 8, 2027; annual coupon indexed at inflation rate,
9.00 % APR in the current coupon period; 30/360) of JSC "ABDI Company"
(Almaty) will be removed from KASE official list.

In the KASE conclusion of August 15, 2012 it is noted that on August 26, 2012 the
term of presence of the mentioned bonds in the buffer category of KASE official
list expires. In accordance with item 13-9 of the Appendix to Order # 04.2-09/119
of Chairman of the Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation of
Activities of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty "On Setting Requirements
for Issuers, Whose Securities Admissible or Admitted to the Official list of
Special Trading Floor of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty, and for Such
Securities" of May 8, 2008 the maximum term of presence of debt securities in the
buffer category of KASE official list makes up 12 months from the date of the
decision on transfer of debt securities into the buffer category. Until now JSC
"ABDI Company" had not removed reasons which lead to transfer of its securities
into the buffer category.

Based on the above-mentioned and in accordance with sub-item 7) item 13-16 of
the mentioned Appendix, the mentioned bonds were removed from KASE official list.

The indicated bonds were included into the "A" category of KASE official list from
January 8, 2008; from September 1, 2008 they were transferred into the second
category of KASE official list's Non-Rated Debt Securities. From August 27, 2011
they were moved into KASE official list's buffer category. Trading in them was
opened from April 17, 2008.

During the mentioned bonds' circulation at KASE their yield to maturity for buyer
(on transactions concluded by open trades method) varied from 5.84 to 70.00 %
APR.

Date: 2012-08-10
Title: KASE removes bonds KZ2C0Y05C515 (KZ2C00000818, AGKKb1) of Agricultural credit corporation (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices' representative list due to circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1172330/
Body: /KASE, August 10, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on
Indices and Securities valuation from August 10, 2012 removed from the
representative list of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds
KZ2C0Y05C515 (KZ2C00000818, KASE official list, Rated Debt Securities
category, AGKKb1; KZT1,000, KZT3.0 bn; August 10, 2007 - August 10, 2012;
semi-annual coupon indexed at inflation rate, 7.90 % APR for the final coupon
period; 30/360) of JSC "Agricultural credit corporation" (Astana)  due to
circulation term expiry.

From August 10, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9997597, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9998516, KASE_BY - 1.6076222. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP
equaled to 0.9966559, KASE_BC - 0.9950085 and 1.6074511 for KASE_BY,
accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without
account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited to
fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds in
accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Earlier there was a piece of KASE news of August 10, 2012 "Bonds
KZ2C0Y05C515 (KZ2C00000818, AGKKb1) of Agricultural credit corporation
(Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry"
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1172317

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2012-08-10]

KASE_BP equaled 1.0071701, KASE_BC - 1.0085418 and 1.6070211 for
KASE_BY accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited 
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds 
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation 
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2012-07-26]

Title: KASE removed from KASE_B* series indices representative list bonds KZ2C0Y03D492 (KZ2C00000982, KZTCb2) of KazTransCom (Kazakhstan) due to circulation term expiry
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1169593/
Body: /KASE, May 23, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Committee on Indices and 
Securities Valuation removed beginning May 23, 2012 from the representative list 
of indices KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds KZ2C0Y03D492 (KZ2C00000982, KASE 
official list Non-rated Debt Securities first subcategory, KZTCb2; KZT1,000, 
KZT3.0 bn; July 1, 09 - July 1, 12; four month coupon 10.00 % APR; 30/360) 
of KazTransCom (Almaty) due to circulation term expiry.

From July 2, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0071505, when calculating KASE_BC -
1.0085194, KASE_BY - 1.6076804. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP
equaled 1.0032505, KASE_BC - 1.0078544 and 1.6076840 for KASE_BY
accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without
account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited 
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds 
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Previously KASE published news of July 2, 2012 "Bonds KZ2C0Y03D492
(KZ2C00000982, KZTCb2) of KazTransCom (Kazakhstan) removed from KASE
official list due to circulation term expiry" at
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1169555

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available 
at http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Date: 2012-05-16
Title: KASE removes bonds KZPC0Y05B651 (KZ2C00000537, CCBNb17) of Bank CenterCredit (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices' representative list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1167039/
Body: /KASE, May 16, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Risk Committee
from May 16, 2012 removed from the representative list of indices KASE_BY,
KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds KZPC0Y05B651 (KZ2C00000537, KASE official list, 
first sub-category of Rated Debt Securities category, CCBNb17; KZT100, 
KZT5.0 bn; May 16, 2007 - May 16, 2012; annual coupon 8.50 % APR; 30/360) 
of JSC "Bank CenterCredit" (Almaty) have been removed from KASE
official list due to the circulation term expiry.

From May 16, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9981766, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9985497, KASE_BY - 1.6989588. Before the mentioned date (К) for
KASE_BP equaled to 0.9981698, KASE_BC - 0.9985500  and 1.6989615 for
KASE_BY, accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net"
prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited to
fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds in
accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The
limitation is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Earlier there was a related piece of KASE news of May 16, 2012 "Bonds
KZPC0Y05B651 (KZ2C00000537, CCBNb17) of Bank CenterCredit
(Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry", at
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1167020

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

[2012-05-16]

  second subcategory, TMLZb1; KZT1,000, KZT500.0 mln, April 3, 07 - April 3, 
  12; inflation rate indexed semi-annual coupon, 11.00 % APR for the last 
  coupon period; 30/360) of Temirleasing (Almaty).

The mentioned bonds have been removed from KASE_B* series indices
representative list due to circulation term expiry.

From April 3, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 0.9978592, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9993423, KASE_BY - 1.6948967. Before the mentioned date (К) for
KASE_BP equaled 0.9978647, KASE_BC - 0.9993441 and 1.6950085 for
KASE_BY accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices
without account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by 
"net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited 
to fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds 
in accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation 
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

(Kazakhstan) removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry" -

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at

Depository correspondent account till 03:00 p.m. ALT (Т+0).

by the closed method shall be accepted. Market orders acceptance ratio --
70%.

in compliance with article 14 of chapter 3 of the Methodology of Bonds 
Yield Calculation and Amount of Deals in Bonds available at
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/bond_yield_eng.pdf

The method of acceptance of limited and market orders for purchase - at 
the cut-off price. The issuer cuts off all orders with prices that below 
or equal to a cut-off price.

Only KASE stock market members may submit application for participation in
the trades. Other investors can submit orders through those legal entities.

The full list of stock market members is available at
http://www.kase.kz/en/membership

The bonds issue prospectus is available on KASE website at

Date: 2012-01-20
Title: KASE removes bonds KZPC1Y07B465 (KZ2C00001386, CSBNb5) of Kaspi Bank (Kazakhstan) from KASE_B* series indices' representative list
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1161217/
Body: /KASE, January 20, 12/ - Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Risk Committee
from January 20, 2012 removed from the representative list of indices
KASE_BY, KASE_BP and KASE_BC bonds KZPC1Y07B465 (KZ2C00001386,
KASE official list, first sub-category of Non-Rated Debt Securities category,
CSBNb5; KZT20,000, KZT3.5 bn; January 20, 2005 - January 20, 2012; semi-
annual coupon indexed at inflation rate, 9.30 % APR in the last coupon period;
30/360) of JSC "Kaspi Bank" (Almaty) have been removed from KASE official
list due to the circulation term expiry.

From January 20, 2012, when calculating the index KASE_BP KASE will use the
adjustment coefficient (К), equal to 1.0009349, when calculating KASE_BC -
0.9988601, KASE_BY - 1.6830252. Before the mentioned date (К) for KASE_BP
equaled to 1.0009482, KASE_BC - 0.9988747 and 1.6830259 for KASE_BY,
accordingly.

KASE_BY - corporate bond yield index.

KASE_BC - corporate bond price index calculated according to the prices without
account to accrued (accrued, but not paid) interest thereon (by "net" prices).

KASE_BP - corporate bond price index calculated with account to all accrued
interest thereon, including that not paid.

All of the indicated indices are calculated by KASE once a day according to
results of trades in corporate bonds.

The unit weight of each denomination of bond in value of indicators is limited to
fifteen percent. At that, only volume of outstanding and not redeemed bonds in
accordance with documents available at KASE shall be accounted. The limitation
is made through the restrictive coefficient.

Earlier there was a related piece of KASE news of January 20, 2012 "Bonds
KZPC1Y07B465 (KZ2C00001386, CSBNb5) of Kaspi Bank (Kazakhstan)
removed from KASE official list due to circulation term expiry" -
http://www.kase.kz/en/news/show/1161198

The methodology of calculation of indices is regulated by the KASE internal
document "Methodology of Calculation of Stock Market Indicators", available at
http://www.kase.kz/files/normative_base/indicators_met_eng.pdf

Title: From April 5 bonds of Kazakhstan Kagazy transferred from KASE official list's buffer category to second sub-category of Non-Rated Debt Securities
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1132751/
Body: /KASE, April 5, 11/ - By Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Listing
Commission decision from April 5, 2011 the following bonds of Kazakhstan
Kagazy (Almaty region) are transferred from KASE official list's "buffer
category" into the second sub-category of "Non-Rated Debt Securities"
category:

- KZP01Y20C023, KZ2C00000263 (KKAGb2; KZT1.119, KZT3.5 bn; April 7,
  2006 - March 18, 2026, semi-annual coupon 13.00 % APR; 30/360);

- KZP02Y22C027, KZ2C00000271 (KKAGb3; KZT1.1325, KZT3.5 bn; August
  22, 2006 - March 18, 2028, semi-annual coupon 13.00 % APR; 30/360);

- KZ2C0Y20D116, KZ2C00000255 (KKAGb4; KZT117.8667, KZT12.0 bn;
  August 29, 2008 - February 25, 2028, semi-annual coupon 13.00 % APR;
  30/360).

In a KASE conclusion of April 1, 2011 it is mentioned that the reason for
transfer of the mentioned bonds into KASE official list's "buffer category"
was restructuring of Kazakhstan Kagazy's liabilities. The term of presence
of the said bonds in the official list's "buffer category" expired on
February 16, 2011.

According to documents presented to KASE in March 2011, restructuring of
Kazakhstan Kagazy's liabilities was completed.

Due to the removal by Kazakhstan Kagazy of reasons for transfer of the said
bonds into the "buffer category" and fulfillment of all requirements set by
the Appendix to the Order # 04.2-09/119 of the Chairman of the Agency of the
Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation of Activities of the Regional Financial
Center of Almaty dated May 8, 2008 - "On Establishment of Requirements for
Issuers, whose Securities are Admissible or Admitted to the Official list
of the Special Trading Floor of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty,
and for such Securities" and obligatory for the transfer of the named bonds
into the second sub-category of the "Non-Rated Debt Securities" category, the
said bonds have been moved from the "buffer category" into the second sub-
category of KASE official list's "Non-Rated Debt Securities" category.

[2011-04-05]

Date: 2011-04-05
Title: From April 5 bonds KZ2P0Y07D045 (AESOb1) of Almatyenergosbyt transferred from KASE official list's buffer category to second sub-category of Non-Rated Debt Securities
Link: https://kase.kz/en/information/news/show/1132722/
Body: /KASE, April 5, 11/ - By Kazakhstan Stock Exchange (KASE) Listing
Commission decision from April 5, 2011 bonds KZ2P0Y07D045 (AESOb1; KZT1,
KZT900.0 m, July 2, 2008 - July 2, 2015; semi-annual coupon 15.00 % APR;
30/360) of Almatyenergosbyt (Almaty) are transferred from KASE official
list's "buffer category" into the second sub-category of "Non-Rated Debt
Securities" category.

In a KASE conclusion of March 24, 2011 it is mentioned that the reason for
transfer of the mentioned bonds into the "buffer category" was the non-
compliance of Almatyenergosbyt with the listing requirement as for the net
worth's size (the net worth of Almatyenergosbyt as of December 31, 2009 made
up KZT327.7 m tenge (287,613 MCI)), set in sub-item 5) of item 11 of the
Appendix to the Order # 04.2-09/119 of the Chairman of the Agency of the
Republic of Kazakhstan on Regulation of Activities of the Regional Financial
Center of Almaty dated May 8, 2008 - "On Establishment of Requirements for
Issuers, whose Securities are Admissible or Admitted to the Official list
of the Special Trading Floor of the Regional Financial Center of Almaty,
and for such Securities" at 340,000 MCI.

As Almatyenergosbyt has removed all reasons for the transfer of the said
bonds into the "buffer category" and fulfilled all the requirements set
forth by the mentioned Appendix and obligatory for the transfer of the
named bonds into the second sub-category of the "Non-Rated Debt Securities"
category, the said bonds have been moved from the "buffer category" into
the second sub-category of KASE official list's "Non-Rated Debt Securities"
category.

The mentioned bonds were from July 2, 2008 included into the second sub-
category of the "Non-Rated Debt Securities" category of the official list
of the special trading floor at the Regional Financial Center of Almaty.
From November 9, 2009 they were transferred into the second sub-category
of KASE official list's "Non-Rated Debt Securities" category, and from
November 18, 2010 - into KASE official list's "buffer category". Trading
in the bonds was opened on July 9, 2008.
